name: Shadow’s Respite
body:
Prerequisite(s): Shadow class, character level 7th

Benefit(s): Once per day, when reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, you can immediately use your Shadow Step ability (if available) as an immediate action before falling unconscious. If you don’t have Shadow Step, you instead gain concealment for 1 round.
